package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/config"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/logging"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/persistence/clickhouse"
	httptransport "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http"
	apiv1 "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	pkglog "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/log"
)

func main() {
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	application, err := newApplication(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to init app: %v", err)
	}
	if err := application.Run(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("app stopped with error: %v", err)
	}
}

// application owns process composition and lifecycle; domain and use cases
// receive only their ports from this composition root.
type application struct {
	cfg               *config.Config
	logger            pkglog.Logger
	chClient          *clickhouse.Client
	eventSink         *clickhouse.BufferedEventSink
	activityPublisher *nats.InterestingActivityPublisher
	echo              *echo.Echo
}

func newApplication(ctx context.Context) (*application, error) {
	cfg := config.MustLoad()
	logger := pkglog.New(cfg.AppEnv)

	chClient, err := clickhouse.NewClient(ctx, cfg.ClickHouseDSN)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	repo := clickhouse.NewEventRepository(chClient.Conn())
	summaryRepo := clickhouse.NewSummaryRepository(chClient.Conn())
	sessionSummaryRepo := clickhouse.NewLearningSessionSummaryRepository(chClient.Conn())
	sink := clickhouse.NewBufferedEventSink(repo, cfg.BatchSize, cfg.BatchFlushTimeout, cfg.BufferSize, logger)
	var activityPublisher *nats.InterestingActivityPublisher
	if cfg.NATSURL != "" {
		activityPublisher, err = nats.NewInterestingActivityPublisher(cfg.NATSURL, cfg.NATSPublishTimeout)
		if err != nil {
			sink.Close()
			_ = chClient.Conn().Close()
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	service := usecase.NewEventService(sink, logging.NewZerologErrorLogger(logger), activityPublisher)
	summaryService := usecase.NewSummaryService(summaryRepo)
	sessionSummaryService := usecase.NewLearningSessionSummaryService(sessionSummaryRepo)
	handler := handlers.NewStatHandler(service, summaryService, sessionSummaryService, logger)
	router := httptransport.NewRouter(cfg, apiv1.NewRouter(handler), sessionSummaryService)

	e := echo.New()
	router.Setup(e)

	return &application{
		cfg:               cfg,
		logger:            logger,
		chClient:          chClient,
		eventSink:         sink,
		activityPublisher: activityPublisher,
		echo:              e,
	}, nil
}

func (a *application) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	defer a.eventSink.Close()
	if a.activityPublisher != nil {
		defer a.activityPublisher.Close()
	}

	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), a.cfg.ShutdownTimeout)
		defer cancel()
		_ = a.echo.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
	}()

	go func() {
		addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", a.cfg.HTTPHost, a.cfg.HTTPPort)
		a.logger.Info().Msgf("starting http server on %s", addr)
		errCh <- a.echo.Start(addr)
	}()

	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil
	case err := <-errCh:
		if errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}
}
